text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here, Trainer. The autumn<n>Tenno Sho—my
race against Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm not here to jog. My goal is first<n>place. I fully
intend to win!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If I don't, then I can't call myself the<n>greatest villain
ever.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We've done all sorts of training to<n>reach our goal.
All that's left is...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I haven't practiced my villain voice at<n>all. How are
the fans going to get<n>excited now?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, you naughty child. ♪ How<n>dare you defy
me? Kneel before your<n>master!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Beg for my forgiveness, and you<n>might yet receive
it... ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: R-right? I'm actually enjoying myself<n>quite a bit...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I don't think I should be. I'll tone<n>it down a
smidge if I win!
